description: Accepted HX-30HM actuator families for the quadruped. The single source of motor values: scenes, gait-search recipes and viewers apply or check this registry (sim_runtime::actuator_registry) and record the family hashes they used. Change a family only by promoting new evidence and updating its hash here.

hx30hm-provisional.accepted: Provisional estimates (controller v2 of the 2026-09-19 gait-generation study); used where no joint-role measurement exists (worm). Not a calibration.

hx30hm-knee-measured.accepted: 2026-09-23: campaign-1790182543587 servo 1 (knee). Back-EMF/torque constant, gear friction and envelope derived; others estimated.

hx30hm-hip-measured.accepted: 2026-09-23: campaign-1790182543587 servo 3 (belt/hip). Motor-side values; the run had no belt limits, so joint alignment (not these motor values) may be affected by a belt skip.
